messages:
mika: Heads up — hitting duplicate POSTs from the Android sample when flipping network mid-auth. Seen on Pixel 6/7, Android 13/15.

mika: Repro: cold start -> start signin -> toggle wifi off -> mobile on while Token refresh is inflight. Server sees two identical side-effecting POSTs.

mika: Interceptor is basically: 
```
class AuthInterceptor: Interceptor {
  override fun intercept(chain: Interceptor.Chain): Response {
    val token = TokenProvider.getSyncToken() // blocks/refreshes
    val req = chain.request().newBuilder().addHeader("Authorization", "Bearer $token").build()
    return chain.proceed(req)
  }
}
```

nate: Any custom CallAdapter or wrapper around Retrofit suspend calls? Could resume/re-enqueue on coroutine dispatcher switch.

mika: No custom adapters. Using Retrofit suspend adapter. Timeouts left as defaults. Behavior correlates with connectivity broadcasts.

suzie: Quick suspicion: debug build had minifyEnabled=true accidentally. R8 can change bridge timing or inline things used by coroutine/generate code.

mika: Confirmed — turning off minify in debug made dupes go away locally. With minify=true dupes ~50-70% in quick runs.

nate: Short-term: disable debug minify, add -keep for auth/token classes. Medium: add single-flight dedupe for token refresh and ensure TokenProvider doesn't recreate OkHttpClient or reuse Request objects.

devx-ci: Filing issue + attaching minified/non-minified APKs and logs. Consider adding an optional nightly e2e that toggles connectivity for the signin flow.

runtime-bot: FYI - recent okhttp bump changed dispatcher wake semantics slightly; tagging eng-runtime.

eng-runtime: We'll pair on the APKs/logs. Can't reproduce in our harness yet, but R8+client interaction is plausible. Recommend: 1) keep debug minify off, 2) add proguard keep rules like `-keep class com.redwood.sample.auth.** { *; }`, 3) implement single-flight token refresh.

mika: Thanks — will disable minify in debug, add keep rule, push repro artifacts, and schedule pairing.
